project_models.name: Host Organism / Cellular Expression (Microbial, Plant, Mammalian)
project_models.pillar1_placeholder: e.g. Pseudomonas putida, Pichia pastoris, Triticum aestivum
project_models.pillar1_desc: The living cell line, bacterial strain, yeast, or plant model expressing the construct.
project_models.pillar2_placeholder: e.g. Engineered PETase, CRISPR-Cas12a, TaHKT1;5 transporter
project_models.pillar2_desc: The specific protein, promoter, catalytic mechanism, or molecular intervention.
project_models.pillar3_placeholder: e.g. Accelerated PET depolymerization, foliar salinity exclusion
project_models.pillar3_desc: The substrate, clinical phenotype, or quantitative metric being improved.

project_models.name: Cell-Free Diagnostics / Biosensors / Molecular Assays (No Living Host)
project_models.pillar1_label: Diagnostic System / Reaction Matrix / Sample Matrix
project_models.pillar1_placeholder: e.g. Paper lateral flow strip, lyophilized cell-free lysate, hospital effluent
project_models.pillar1_desc: The test platform, detection matrix, clinical fluid, or environmental sample.
project_models.pillar2_label: Recognition Element / Molecular Probe / Assay Mechanism
project_models.pillar2_placeholder: e.g. Cas12a-crRNA fluorescent reporter, DNA aptamer, gold nanoparticles
project_models.pillar2_desc: The molecular sensor, enzymatic cascade, or amplification mechanism.
project_models.pillar3_placeholder: e.g. mcr-1 antibiotic resistance gene, circulating microRNA, femtomolar LOD
project_models.pillar3_desc: The target analyte and the required analytical sensitivity.

project_models.name: Biomaterials / Nanotechnology / Drug Delivery Formulations
project_models.pillar1_label: Carrier Material / Nanomaterial Matrix / Formulation Vehicle
project_models.pillar1_placeholder: e.g. Chitosan-PLGA nanoparticles, lipid nanoparticles (LNPs), PEG hydrogel
project_models.pillar1_desc: The delivery vehicle, polymeric scaffold, or synthetic nanomaterial.
project_models.pillar2_label: Bioactive Cargo / Conjugated Ligand / Release Mechanism
project_models.pillar2_placeholder: e.g. siRNA cargo, targeting transferrin peptide, pH-responsive cleavage
project_models.pillar2_desc: The therapeutic biomolecule, targeting moiety, or controlled-release trigger.
project_models.pillar3_placeholder: e.g. Triple-negative breast cancer, intracellular delivery efficiency >80%
project_models.pillar3_desc: The disease tissue and quantitative pharmacodynamic target.

project_models.name: Environmental Biotechnology / Bioremediation / Waste Streams
project_models.pillar1_label: Contaminated Matrix / Bioreactor System / Effluent Stream
project_models.pillar1_placeholder: e.g. Industrial textile wastewater, saline agricultural drainage, sludge matrix
project_models.pillar1_desc: The environmental medium, soil type, or industrial effluent being treated.
project_models.pillar2_label: Biocatalytic Consortium / Immobilized Enzyme / Filtration Media
project_models.pillar2_placeholder: e.g. Cross-linked enzyme aggregates (CLEAs), microbial biofilm, laccase
project_models.pillar2_desc: The catalytic agent, biofilm system, or enzymatic treatment mechanism.
project_models.pillar3_placeholder: e.g. Azo dye decolorization >95%, heavy metal reduction <0.1 mg/L
project_models.pillar3_desc: The specific chemical contaminant and required regulatory discharge limit.

project_models.name: Computational Biology / In Silico Modeling / Structural Bioinformatics
project_models.pillar1_label: Computational Framework / Molecular Model / Target Database
project_models.pillar1_placeholder: e.g. AlphaFold predicted structure, PDB 6EQE, molecular dynamics ensemble
project_models.pillar1_desc: The macromolecular coordinate model, simulation platform, or dataset.
project_models.pillar2_label: In Silico Algorithm / Mutagenesis Strategy / Screening Pipeline
project_models.pillar2_placeholder: e.g. Rosetta flex ddG, QM/MM catalytic profiling, virtual docking
project_models.pillar2_desc: The computational algorithm, free energy calculation, or scoring function.
project_models.pillar3_placeholder: e.g. Binding affinity delta-G < -10 kcal/mol, catalytic activation barrier
project_models.pillar3_desc: The quantitative thermodynamic or kinetic parameter being optimized.

criteria.name: Title
criteria.description: Concise & descriptive of the molecular mechanism, experimental system, target metric, and application.
criteria.formula: [Molecular Mechanism / Tool] in [Experimental System / Matrix] to [Target Metric] for [Application]

criteria.name: Structured Abstract
criteria.description: Balanced across Problem/Significance (2%), Methodology (2%), Expected Outcomes (1%), and Concluding Relevance.

subsections.name: State of the Art & Current Methodological Baselines
Critical Scientific Knowledge Gap & Mechanistic Flaw
Overall Project Aim, Mechanistic Hypothesis & Specific Objectives

criteria.name: Methodology
criteria.guidance: Written strictly in FUTURE TENSE ('will be assayed', 'will be synthesized'). Must include positive/negative experimental controls and validated quantitative assays.

criteria.name: Specific Objectives (Specific Aims)
criteria.guidance: 3 discrete, decoupled objectives with quantitative Go/No-Go milestones, ensuring no Domino Collapse dependency.

criteria.name: Expected Outcomes & Long-Term Impact (Section 10)
criteria.guidance: 5% for concrete visual deliverables and figures; 5% for long-term Academic, Translational, and Societal Impact answering 'Why do the results matter?'

criteria.name: Competitive Advantage, Competitor Analysis & USPs
criteria.guidance: 2.5% for Competitor Analysis Matrix comparing Incumbent vs Emerging vs Proposed; 2.5% for specific USP naming a real competitor (no 'traditional methods' strawman).

criteria.name: Biotechnology SWOT & PESTEL Analysis
criteria.guidance: Authentic biochemical failure modes (e.g. inclusion bodies, protease sensitivity) avoiding student clichés ('we are students'). All 6 PESTEL dimensions.

criteria.name: Gantt Timeline & Feasibility Decision Gates
criteria.guidance: Clear monthly work package schedule with explicit Go/No-Go decision milestones.

criteria.name: Tabulated Itemized Budget
criteria.guidance: Itemized 5-category budget table (Consumables, Personnel, Equipment, Overhead, Travel) with justifications.

criteria.name: References & 60% Recency Rule
criteria.guidance: At least 60% of peer-reviewed references published between 2021 and 2026. Consistent Harvard or Vancouver style.
